message: fix(combat): refresh short approach budget after confirmed hits within a fixed pursuit radius
purpose: The denser-world live regression found held combat exhausted its single initial approach budget after two successful hits, leaving a starter creature alive at 0.2 HP. Correct the control behavior, not the test. A server-acknowledged attack opens another short approach window; replanning or an unaccepted request cannot reset it. Keep each window at 2.5 tiles and 1.5 seconds, and add an absolute six-tile engagement bound. Retain the original live encounter timeout and damage/reward checks.

replacements.old: // Replanning never resets the time or total travel budget of this key press.
replacements.new:
// Replanning never resets this window. Confirmed hits may refresh the
            // short window, but never the fixed engagement-origin distance bound.

double remaining = Math.Min(2.5 - approachTravelled, Math.Max(0, 6 - engagementOrigin.Distance(snapshot.Self.Position)));
                var path = ExperienceRules.ApproachPath(snapshot.Self, target, Data, remaining);

replacements.old: check(data.Self.LastAction==original.Self.LastAction,"Target selection does not issue server combat or movement commands");

replacements.new:
## Bounded pursuit

Held basic attacks retain a 2.5-tile, 1.5-second approach window. A newer authoritative attack cooldown confirms an accepted attack and opens a fresh window. Replanning and rejected requests do not refresh it. A separate six-tile bound from the engagement origin prevents repeated windows from producing uncontrolled long-distance pursuit. Releasing the key, typing, menus, death and disconnect still stop combat. The original live starter encounter remains a required test; its timeout was not extended.
